name: Frederick County, MD
findings: Frederick County has 1,017 nonprofit organizations. 465 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 365 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Frederick County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Frederick County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
